timestamped_transcript.text: My ex-husband stared at me in the frozen aisle like he'd seen a ghost.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: I nearly cried there in the parking lot, but my sister flew in and proved it wasn't my fault.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: That Thursday, I came home too soon. Heard them upstairs in our room.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Thirty-one beside fifty-six in our bed. No scream, no tears, not one word said.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: I shut the door and sat in the dark 'til the midnight mirror tore me apart.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: At fifty-four, I barely knew the swollen face I was looking into.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Six months on my shot, the hunger was gone, but my belly stayed out, round and hard as a stone.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Walked every morning, kept the routine. Ate half of what I used to, ate clean.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Sulfur burps, bloat, four days without going. Worse every week, and I couldn't say why.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: I don't know her. Maybe he felt the same.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: I called my sister, Denise. Two years on the same shot as me.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: She'd been where I was, and she'd found the way.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: She flew in next day, no hug at the door. "We have work. You won't stay like this anymore."
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Two days in, she asked about my belly. "It's been like this since the second month."
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: She said, "You don't need to feel ashamed. You didn't even know what the shot had changed."
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: It slows your stomach down on purpose, that's how it works. So the food you ate just sits there. Not for hours. For days. It ferments, it bloats, it backs up, and the fiber and the MiraLAX just pile on more.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Six months pushing against a locked door. Your gut couldn't let go anymore.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: For the first time, I could finally see. It wasn't age, it wasn't me.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: More fiber won't push a slowed gut away. My body never betrayed me.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: She set two capsules in front of me. GLP-1 SOS, Daily Gut Relief.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Two hundred fifty milligrams of magnesium pulls water in gently and softens what's been sitting there for days.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Two hundred milligrams of ginger gets the stomach moving again, so nothing sits long enough to ferment.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Two with dinner. That's it.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Built for a slowed gut, not a normal one. It works with the shot, not against it.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Day three, the burps were gone.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Week two, mornings like clockwork.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Week four, the bloat was too.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: No other changes, I stayed on my shot. It just followed through.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Week six, my old black dress fit like new after a year hidden out of view.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Soon after, frozen aisle, she at his side. He stared like he couldn't believe his eyes.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: "You look incredible. What did you do?" I gave him silence, kept walking through.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: I felt his eyes 'til I left his view.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: He didn't leave because I grew old. He left when cowardice took hold.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: My body was never the one to blame. More fiber won't push a slowed gut away.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: The only thing that worked for me, GLP-1 SOS, finally.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Denise says it sells out all the time. I checked yesterday, and you're end of the line.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: If the button still shows below, get it before the last ones go.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: Sixty days, money back, no questions asked.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: And stop blaming yourself at all.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

timestamped_transcript.text: This was never, ever your fault.
timestamped_transcript.speaker: Narrator

narrative_sections.visual_summary: An animated middle-aged man looks shocked in a grocery store. An animated woman cries in her car, then at home looking at a photo of herself (younger and thinner) with the same man. Her sister consoles her. She is shown coming home, then finding her husband in bed with a younger woman. She sits sadly in the dark, looks despairingly in a mirror, eats sadly, exercises with difficulty, and has digestive discomfort.
narrative_sections.paraphrased_story_content: A woman is triggered by seeing her ex-husband. She recalls the trauma of finding him cheating on her and how her physical appearance has declined since. Despite being on a 'shot' that reduces hunger and trying to eat clean and exercise, she suffers from severe bloating, constipation ('four days without going'), and burps, feeling her body is not her own.
narrative_sections.questions_and_resolutions: Question: Why did her ex stare like he'd seen a ghost? (Hook) Question: Why isn't her diet, exercise, and 'shot' working to reduce her belly bloat?

narrative_sections.visual_summary: The woman calls her sister on the phone. The sister arrives at her house. They talk in the kitchen. The sister explains the problem, showing animated depictions of a sad, blue, frozen stomach, and then a clogged intestine where vegetables and fiber pile up behind a large blockage. Products for 'MiraLAX' and 'Fiber Well' are shown with disapproval by the sister.
narrative_sections.paraphrased_story_content: She calls her sister, Denise, who has been on the same 'shot' for two years and found a solution. Denise explains that the shot slows stomach emptying on purpose. Food sits for days, ferments, and causes bloat and backups. Standard remedies like fiber and MiraLAX only make the problem worse by adding more bulk. The woman realizes her body isn't betraying her; the issue is a 'slowed gut'.
narrative_sections.questions_and_resolutions: Resolved: Her diet and exercise aren't working because of a medication-induced side effect ('slowed gut'), not a personal failing.

narrative_sections.visual_summary: The sister presents a supplement bottle labeled 'GLP-1 SOS Daily Gut Relief'. An animated sequence shows magnesium pulling water into the intestine to soften a blockage, and another shows ginger stimulating a happy, orange stomach to empty itself. The bottle is shown next to a GLP-1 style injection pen.
narrative_sections.paraphrased_story_content: The sister's solution is a supplement called 'GLP-1 SOS'. It's explained that its magnesium softens the blockage by pulling in water, while its ginger helps the stomach empty faster, preventing fermentation. The product is designed to work *with* the shot, not against it.
narrative_sections.questions_and_resolutions: Question: What is the solution? Resolved: The proposed solution is the supplement GLP-1 SOS.

narrative_sections.visual_summary: A 'RESULTS MAY VARY' disclaimer appears. The main character is shown happily drinking coffee, stretching, looking in the mirror at her flatter stomach, and fitting into an old black dress. The scene returns to the grocery store where she, now looking slimmer and confident, walks past her shocked ex-husband and his younger partner. He speaks to her, but she ignores him and walks away. The final shot is her, happy and healthy, in a white shirt.
narrative_sections.paraphrased_story_content: The ad claims rapid results: burps gone in three days, regular bowel movements in two weeks, and bloat gone in four weeks. After six weeks, she fits into her old dress. When she sees her ex again, he is stunned by her transformation. She now realizes he left due to his own 'cowardice', not because she 'grew old', and her body was never to blame.
narrative_sections.questions_and_resolutions: Resolved: The initial hook is paid off. He stared because she has transformed her appearance, looking confident and slim.

narrative_sections.visual_summary: The woman is shown holding the product bottle. She is on a video call with her happy sister. A hand takes the product off a store shelf. The product is shown on a nightstand. She is shown smiling peacefully in a garden. The ad ends with a product shot and a URL.
narrative_sections.paraphrased_story_content: The ad concludes by reiterating the product's name and purpose. The sister warns it sells out frequently. A call to action urges viewers to check availability via a button. A money-back guarantee is offered, and the final message is one of reassurance: 'This was never, ever your fault.'
narrative_sections.questions_and_resolutions: Final CTA and offer are presented.
